2609.15364.title: RSIAgent: Autonomous Exploration for Recursive Self-improvement in New Environments
2609.15364.paper_summary: Digital agents must often adapt to new environments whose interfaces, tools, and failure modes are not fully captured by pretrained models. We introduce \textbf{RSIAgent}, a training-free multi-agent framework for recursive self-improvement through autonomous memory construction. RSIAgent coordinates curriculum, actor, and verifier agents to continually explore the environment, validate outcomes, and retain environment-specific knowledge, including reusable causal relationships between actions, conditions, and consequences. It further adopts a \textbf{broad-then-deep} exploration strategy, combining parallel broad recursive self-exploration for discovering diverse environment structures with focused deep self-exploration for uncovering hard cases, hidden constraints, boundary conditions, and previously unknown causal dependencies. The resulting memory is frozen and can be directly reused for downstream tasks without updating model parameters. Experiments on OSWorld-v2 and Agent's Last Exam show that RSIAgent substantially improves strong open-source models, enabling Kimi-K3 and GLM-5.3 to outperform frontier closed-source models including GPT-6.
2609.15364.paper_summary_zh: 數位代理人常常必須適應新的環境，這些環境的介面、工具和故障模式並未被預訓練模型充分捕捉。我們介紹了 \textbf{RSIAgent}，這是一個無需訓練的多代理框架，旨在通過自主記憶構建實現遞歸自我改進。RSIAgent 協調課程、行為者和驗證者代理人，不斷探索環境、驗證結果並保留環境特定知識，包括行動、條件和後果之間可重用的因果關係。它進一步採用 \textbf{廣泛然後深入} 的探索策略，結合平行的廣泛遞歸自我探索以發現多樣的環境結構，與針對困難案例、隱藏約束、邊界條件和先前未知的因果依賴進行的深入自我探索。所產生的記憶是凍結的，可以直接重用於下游任務，而無需更新模型參數。在 OSWorld-v2 和 Agent's Last Exam 上的實驗顯示，RSIAgent 顯著改善了強大的開源模型，使 Kimi-K3 和 GLM-5.3 超越了包括 GPT-6 在內的前沿封閉源模型。
